content: Tembok di belakang rumah itu tinggi
sekali, sehingga anjing tetangga tidak
bisa masuk.
= The wall behind that house is so high
that the neighbours' dog cannot get in.
That is card one of this pack, and it is
twice the length of a Core sentence.
Nothing in it is harder. There is simply
more of it between the full stops.
A long Indonesian sentence is two short
ones with a joint between them:
[ tembok itu tinggi sekali ]
sehingga
[ anjing tidak bisa masuk ]
Eleven words do nearly all the joining.
karena       because                  Press 1
...karena harganya sangat murah.
sehingga     so that, and so          Press 2
...sehingga ruang tamu jadi hangat.
ketika       when, at the moment      Press 3
...ketika adik saya berlari di ruang tamu.
meskipun     even though (walaupun)   Press 4
...meskipun cuaca sering buruk.
agar, supaya   so that, in order to
padahal        and yet, when in fact
sebelum        before
setelah        after
All of them stand at the joint, never at
the end.

pronunciation_mappings.1: Setiap pagi kami sarapan di warung karena harganya sangat murah.
pronunciation_mappings.2: Karpet merah itu menutupi lantai, sehingga ruang tamu jadi hangat.
pronunciation_mappings.3: Kopi panas itu tumpah ke karpet ketika adik saya berlari di ruang tamu.
pronunciation_mappings.4: Pagar besi itu masih kuat meskipun cuaca sering buruk.

content: The comma goes at the joint, before the
joining word, when the second half could
stand alone:
Pesanan kami belum juga datang, padahal
kami sudah menunggu hampir setengah jam.
= Our order still has not come, and yet
we have waited nearly half an hour.
karena and sehingga take one too when the
first half is long. agar and supaya take
none: they hang straight off the verb.
Petugas itu memakai rompi kuning agar
mudah terlihat sopir truk.
= That official wears a yellow vest so
lorry drivers can see him easily.
Kami mencari penginapan murah karena
semua hotel di dekat pantai terlalu
mahal.
= We looked for cheap lodgings because
all the hotels near the beach were too
expensive.
Lesson 20 made a doer out of a verb:
penjual, a seller. Add -an and you have
the act, or the place, instead:
penjual     a seller
penjualan   selling, sales
penginapan  lodgings (menginap)
pembayaran  a payment (bayar)
pengiriman  a delivery (kirim)
One -an is the whole difference.
per-...-an is the third of the family, and
it names the system rather than the act.
perdagangan   trade as a whole     Press 1
perawatan     upkeep, care         Press 2
permintaan    demand, a request    Press 3
Sejak jalan baru itu dibuka tahun lalu,
perdagangan antara kedua negara naik
setiap tahun.
= Since that new road opened last year,
trade between the two countries has
risen every year.
Shape does not decide which one a root
takes; the dictionary does. What matters is
what they share: a long word that begins
pe- or per- and ends -an is a noun.

pronunciation_mappings.1: Perdagangan antara kedua negara naik setiap tahun.
pronunciation_mappings.2: Perawatan mesin lama itu memakan biaya besar.

content: Anak-anak mengemasi barang mereka
sebelum makan malam dimulai.
= The children packed their things away
before dinner began.
kemas is the root. The verb you write is
mengemas or mengemasi; the bare root is
cited, not spoken. The sentence shows the
shape a speaker uses.
kemas   mengemas     to pack up
susun   menyusun     to arrange
ikat    mengikat     to tie
tiup    meniup       to blow
tempel  menempel     to stick on
The card teaches the root; the sentence
teaches the shape it wears.
Watch one root take three different
jackets across three cards.
letak   ->  letakkan               Press 1
Tolong letakkan kotak besar di rak.
= Please put the big box on the shelf.
suruh   ->  disuruh                Press 2
Seorang murid disuruh guru menutup
jendela kelas yang masih terbuka.
= A pupil was told by the teacher to
close the window that was still open.
Neither sentence shows the bare root, and
both cards cite it. Learn the root and the
family comes free. Learn only the sentence
form and every relative in it is a
stranger.

pronunciation_mappings.1: Tolong letakkan kotak besar di rak.
pronunciation_mappings.2: Seorang murid disuruh guru menutup jendela kelas.
